purpose: Define the default bilingual source pairing used when adding or reviewing acupoint records.
review_rule: A point can be marked source_checked only after the English location, Chinese location, code, channel, and safety notes have been cross-checked against the core standard or professional textbook source.
display_rule: In each acupoint article page, use external source buttons instead of embedding imprecise locally generated point images. Show AcuPoints.org as English source, CloudTCM as 中文來源, and WHO/textbook materials as Core standard when available.
visual_rule: Do not force a self-made point image unless an accurate, reviewed atlas asset exists. Prefer linking to external reference pages or source images for visual lookup.
